_notes.source_file: proposal.docx sits beside this config in the repo. It is NOT deployed by the vertical — only this config is. The DOCX must be uploaded to obj://microstrate-documents/crm.proposal.docx in the target account first, with a POST (not PUT) to /api/default-storage/object/<bucket>/<key>; a PUT returns 200 and stores nothing.
_notes.payload_contract: A trigger payload MUST supply all eight keys above. Any placeholder with no matching key renders as an empty string, silently, and the PDF still reports success. Re-extract the list from the DOCX after any edit: python3 -c "import zipfile,re;print(sorted(set(re.findall(r'{[^{}]{1,60}}', zipfile.ZipFile('proposal.docx').read('word/document.xml').decode()))))"
